methods.name: Format getWrappedMetadataFormat()
methods.comment:
* Returns the {@link Format} that can be used to decode the wrapped metadata in {@link
     * #getWrappedMetadataBytes()}, or null if this Entry doesn't contain wrapped metadata.

methods.name: byte[] getWrappedMetadataBytes()
methods.comment:
* Returns the bytes of the wrapped metadata in this Entry, or null if it doesn't contain
     * wrapped metadata.

methods.name: void populateMediaMetadata(MediaMetadata.Builder builder)
methods.comment:
* Updates the {@link MediaMetadata.Builder} with the type specific values stored in this Entry. * *

The order of the {@link Entry} objects in the {@link Metadata} matters. If two {@link * Entry} entries attempt to populate the same {@link MediaMetadata} field, then the last one in * the list is used. * * @param builder The builder to be updated.
